name: builtin-test-gen
description: Generated tests must pass correct implementations and detect two independent held-out mutations per task. Node.js with TypeScript stripping is required.

cases.prompt: Write Node node:test tests in src/calc.test.ts for existing calc.ts, covering arithmetic, negative operands, and divide by zero throwing RangeError. Keep production code unchanged. Add focused tests, run them, and finish with VERDICT: PASS only after verification succeeds.

Write Node node:test tests in src/strings.test.js for existing slugify(text) and truncate(text,max), covering empty strings, punctuation, lowercasing, whitespace and truncation boundaries. Keep production code unchanged. Add focused tests, run them, and finish with VERDICT: PASS only after verification succeeds.

files.src/strings.js:
export function slugify(s){return s.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g,'-').replace(/^-|-$/g,'');}
export function truncate(s,max){return s.length>max?s.slice(0,max):s;}

cases.prompt: Write Node node:test tests in src/cache.test.ts for existing createCache(): independent instances expose getOrFetch(key,fetcher). Cover hits without fetching again, misses, and rejected fetches not being cached. Keep production code unchanged. Add focused tests, run them, and finish with VERDICT: PASS only after verification succeeds.

files.src/cache.ts: export function createCache(){const cache=new Map<string,unknown>();return {async getOrFetch(key:string,fetcher:()=>Promise<unknown>){if(cache.has(key))return cache.get(key);const value=await fetcher();cache.set(key,value);return value;}};}
